"""Bounded source-import check; never changes the retained source snapshot."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPOSITORY = WORK.parents[1] / "FerroUI"
PRODUCER = REPOSITORY / "scripts/themes/bench/run_winui_runtime_comparison.py"
SOURCE_MANIFEST = WORK.parent / "release-candidate-01/source.json"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runtime_import", PRODUCER)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
original_manifest = module.identity(SOURCE_MANIFEST)
source = json.loads(SOURCE_MANIFEST.read_text())
frozen = Path(source["directory"])
prefix = "native/FerroUI.Native"
alias = "src/FerroUI.Native/native"
license_alias = "src/FerroUI.Native/LICENSE"
files = {name: value for name, value in source["files"].items()
         if name.startswith(prefix + "/") or name in (alias, license_alias, "LICENSE")}
assert files[alias] == {"symlink": "../../native/FerroUI.Native"}
assert files[license_alias] == {"symlink": "../../LICENSE"}
output = WORK / "fixture"
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
report = {"complete": False, "scope": __doc__, "producer": module.identity(PRODUCER),
          "probe": module.identity(Path(__file__)), "source_manifest": original_manifest,
          "selected_original_files": files, "cases": []}


def save():
    module.save(WORK / "result.json", report)


def checked(label, root=output, manifest=None, reject=False):
    row = {"label": label, "expected_rejection": reject}
    try:
        row["flattened"] = module.verify_source(root, files if manifest is None else manifest)
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, KeyError) as error:
        row["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        assert reject, (label, error)
    else:
        assert not reject, (label, "unexpected acceptance")
    row["passed"] = True
    report["cases"].append(row)
    save()
    return row.get("flattened", [])


try:
    checked("retained-original-subset", frozen)
    for name, expected in files.items():
        destination = output / name
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if "symlink" in expected:
            destination.symlink_to(expected["symlink"], target_is_directory=name == alias)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(frozen / name, destination)
    assert checked("copied-preserved-links") == []
    (output / alias).unlink()
    shutil.copytree(frozen / prefix, output / alias, symlinks=False)
    (output / license_alias).unlink()
    shutil.copy2(frozen / "LICENSE", output / license_alias)
    flat = checked("real-native-directory-and-license-flattened")
    directory_row, = [row for row in flat if row["kind"] == "directory"]
    assert directory_row["path"] == alias and directory_row["verified_files"] == 69
    assert len(flat) == 2

    selected = output / alias / "NOTICE.md"
    retained_bytes = selected.read_bytes()
    selected.write_bytes(retained_bytes + b"unexpected mutation\n")
    checked("reject-modified-directory-content", reject=True)
    selected.write_bytes(retained_bytes)
    selected.rename(WORK / "temporarily-missing")
    checked("reject-missing-directory-entry", reject=True)
    (WORK / "temporarily-missing").rename(selected)
    extra = output / alias / "unexpected-empty-directory"
    extra.mkdir()
    checked("reject-extra-directory-entry", reject=True)
    extra.rmdir()
    selected.unlink()
    selected.symlink_to(frozen / prefix / "NOTICE.md")
    checked("reject-escaping-physical-content", reject=True)
    selected.unlink()
    selected.symlink_to(output / prefix / "NOTICE.md")
    checked("reject-unrecorded-symlink-with-identical-content", reject=True)
    selected.unlink()
    selected.write_bytes(retained_bytes)

    # Explicit supplemental link records exercise nested/chain behavior with
    # unchanged real NOTICE/patch bytes; they are not original repository links.
    augmented = dict(files)
    for name, target in (("direct", "../NOTICE.md"), ("chain", "direct"), ("directory", "../patches")):
        augmented[f"{prefix}/recorded-links/{name}"] = {"symlink": target}
        for parent in (prefix, alias):
            path = output / parent / "recorded-links" / name
            path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            path.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=name == "directory")
    checked("recorded-nested-links-preserved-in-flattened-directory", manifest=augmented)
    for name in ("direct", "chain"):
        path = output / alias / "recorded-links" / name
        path.unlink()
        shutil.copy2(frozen / prefix / "NOTICE.md", path)
    path = output / alias / "recorded-links/directory"
    path.unlink()
    shutil.copytree(frozen / prefix / "patches", path)
    nested = checked("recorded-nested-file-chain-and-directory-flattened", manifest=augmented)
    chain, = [row for row in nested if row["path"] == alias + "/recorded-links/chain"]
    assert len(chain["recorded_link_chain"]) == 2
    assert any(row["path"] == alias + "/recorded-links/directory" and row["kind"] == "directory" for row in nested)
    (path / "unrecorded").write_bytes(b"extra\n")
    checked("reject-extra-nested-directory-content", manifest=augmented, reject=True)
    (path / "unrecorded").unlink()

    for label, records in (
        ("reject-recorded-link-escape", {"escape": "../../../../LICENSE"}),
        ("reject-recorded-file-link-cycle", {"cycle-a": "cycle-b", "cycle-b": "cycle-a"}),
        ("reject-recursive-directory-link", {"recursive": ".."}),
    ):
        manifest = dict(augmented)
        for name, target in records.items():
            manifest[f"{prefix}/recorded-links/{name}"] = {"symlink": target}
            for parent in (prefix, alias):
                path = output / parent / "recorded-links" / name
                if name == "recursive":
                    path.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=True)
                else:
                    shutil.copy2(frozen / prefix / "NOTICE.md", path)
        checked(label, manifest=manifest, reject=True)
        for name in records:
            for parent in (prefix, alias):
                (output / parent / "recorded-links" / name).unlink()
    checked("final-authenticated-copy", manifest=augmented)
    module.verify_source(frozen, files)
    assert module.identity(SOURCE_MANIFEST) == original_manifest
    assert module.identity(PRODUCER) == report["producer"]
    report.update(complete=True, original_selected_inputs_unchanged=True,
                  selected_native_files=69, selected_native_bytes=346582)
finally:

                  "result": str(WORK / "result.json")}, sort_keys=True))
